content.comment_body: Hello, I have a program with a similar setup. However, using the cursor keys on the [product_name] operator device does not work as expected. I only have a basic controller model, so I am unable to test further. Does anyone have any suggestions? Thank you.
If you upload your program (zip file), we can try to identify what might be causing the issue. Which controller type are you using?
Sorry for any inconvenience caused. It was my mistake—I was pressing ESC + cursor simultaneously, instead of first ESC and then the cursor key. Thank you for your response.
No worries, discovering the solution yourself can help you remember it better. Have you already visited [url]? There are plenty of useful examples available there.

Hello, reading the manual explains that to use the cursor buttons in your program, you need to press the ESC key simultaneously. Also, using the search feature in the forum reveals many similar questions that usually have the same resolution.
